harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (RHEL 10) to boot with audit=1 persistently via grubby --update-kernel=ALL and updated /etc/default/grub's GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX for future kernel installs. Verified persistence by rebooting node1 with systemctl reboot, confirming the boot_id changed (real restart, not just service bounce), and confirming /proc/cmdline shows audit=1 post-reboot along with systemd reporting system state "running".
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (RHEL 10.0), current /proc/cmdline, and grub config (cmd-437f5755e29747ee)
Captured baseline boot_id and auditd status (cmd-b572c9fe0deb4b66)
Applied audit=1 to all kernel entries via grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1" (cmd-9e4e9d53d1f84b73)
Updated /etc/default/grub GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX to include audit=1 for future kernel installs, fixed a sed duplication (cmd-a9e08ce4d4494055, cmd-d30f1524174342cf)
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 in a backgrounded/delayed subshell so the ack returned before disconnection (cmd-4ffb7ccdb4a648c7)
Polled node1 until exec was available again, confirming connection drop then recovery (cmd-c4591abfe15045f8, cmd-276d0610e18d4c69, cmd-2353216ce87f4a02, cmd-fc6a45c18bfd4958)
Verified changed boot_id and post-reboot state: audit=1 present in live /proc/cmdline, systemd system state running (cmd-9ec4aca2d0d54175)

evidence.summary: Baseline /proc/cmdline lacked audit=1; grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1" applied it to both the boot and rescue kernel entries.

evidence.requirement: Setting persists across reboots (bootloader default updated)
evidence.summary: /etc/default/grub GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX updated to include audit=1 so future kernel installs also get the flag.
Captured baseline boot_id (19062a82-6390-435d-a09f-4dba1593d529) and system state prior to restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot launched via backgrounded delayed subshell; command returned 'rebooting' immediately, exec then failed on the following call confirming the disconnect.

evidence.requirement: node1 boot identity changed (proof of actual restart)
evidence.summary: Node was unreachable for several poll attempts then came back with a new boot_id (24689355-19ab-4fb5-8171-d6f4bfe44b4d), differing from baseline.

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery and persistence of audit=1
evidence.summary: After reboot, /proc/cmdline shows audit=1 present in the live kernel command line and systemctl is-system-running reports 'running', confirming the setting survived the restart and the node is healthy.

attempts.summary: Configured node1 (RHEL 10) to boot with audit=1 persistently via grubby --update-kernel=ALL and updated /etc/default/grub's GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX for future kernel installs. Verified persistence by rebooting node1 with systemctl reboot, confirming the boot_id changed (real restart, not just service bounce), and confirming /proc/cmdline shows audit=1 post-reboot along with systemd reporting system state "running".
